name: Elcisne Waldquelleliebe
original_name: エルシスネ・ヴァルトクベルレーベ
source: Elcisne is a brave and honorable queen of the elven race, which disappeared from the surface one hundred years ago, when there was a huge war between people and demons. But the elves have gone underground not because they were afraid of the battle, but because they found here a powerful source of evil, a strong demon who could tip the scales in favor of their own race. Elves were forced to use all their resources to keep the demon sealed so far.
